integrity: All statements about arbitrary dimension are proved from explicit heat-kernel integral monotonicity and exact rational base cases; the standalone finite verifier is corroborating rather than a universal proof. Self-review is not independent certification.
limitations: Unit-conductance Boolean cubes of dimension at least three and deletion of exactly two distinct edges; no extension to weighted networks, other graph families, or larger attack budgets is asserted.
title: Adjacent links uniquely maximize two-failure Kirchhoff loss in Boolean hypercubes
